title: Wish, If only, Would rather y condicionales mixtos

lesson.intro: Todas estas estructuras hablan de lo irreal (lo que no es, lo que no fue, lo que prefeririamos) y para eso usan formas de pasado. La clave es el desfase: pasado simple para un presente irreal, past perfect para el arrepentimiento, would para quejarte del comportamiento de otro.

sections.heading: 1 - wish + pasado simple
sections.body:
Para un deseo sobre algo que no es asi ahora: wish + pasado simple (o were para todas las personas con be). Con habilidad: wish + could + base.

Significa: "me gustaria, pero no es asi".
examples: I wish I were on a beach.

sections.heading: 2 - wish + past perfect
sections.body:
Para un arrepentimiento sobre el pasado (algo que hiciste o dejaste de hacer): wish + had (not) + participio.

Significa: "ojala hubiera / no hubiera...".
examples: She wishes she had taken the job.
I wish I had listened to your advice.

sections.heading: 3 - wish + would
sections.body:
Para quejarte del comportamiento molesto de otra persona (o del tiempo, o de una maquina) y desear que cambie: wish + sujeto + would + base.

Normalmente no se dice "I wish I would..." (no controlas tu propio comportamiento asi).
examples: I wish they wouldn't make so much noise.

sections.heading: 4 - If only
sections.body:
Igual que wish pero mas enfatico y emocional. Mismas estructuras:

  • If only + pasado simple (presente irreal).
  • If only + past perfect (arrepentimiento).
  • If only + would (queja de comportamiento).

sections.heading: 5 - would rather
sections.body:
Expresa preferencia.

  • Mismo sujeto: would rather + base → I'd rather stay.
  • Distinto sujeto: would rather + sujeto + pasado simple → I'd rather you stayed / I'd rather you didn't smoke.
  • Comparar: would rather... than... → I'd rather walk than drive.
  • Sobre el pasado: would rather have + participio.
examples: I'd rather you told me the truth.
She'd rather we didn't leave yet.
I'd rather walk than take the bus.

sections.heading: 6 - It's (high) time + pasado
sections.body:
Para decir que algo ya deberia estar pasando (va con retraso): It's time + sujeto + pasado simple.

Con high / about se enfatiza. Sin sujeto concreto: It's time to + infinitivo.
examples: It's high time the government did something.

sections.heading: 7 - Condicionales mixtos
sections.body:
Mezclan condicion y resultado de tiempos distintos:

  • Condicion pasada → resultado presente: If + past perfect, would + base. If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
  • Condicion presente → resultado pasado: If + past simple, would have + participio. If I weren't so shy, I would have asked her out.
examples: If I'd saved money, I'd have a house now.
If I weren't afraid of flying, I would have visited you last summer.
If she had taken the job, she would be living in London now.

sections.heading: 8 - Elegir la estructura de deseo
sections.body:
• Arrepentimiento del pasado → wish / if only + had done.
  • Presente irreal → wish / if only + did / were / could.
  • Queja de un habito ajeno → wish / if only + would.
  • Preferencia → would rather (+ base, o + sujeto + pasado).
  • Algo con retraso → It's time + pasado.

Todas usan formas de pasado para lo irreal.
examples: It's high time you made a decision.

contrast.title: Deseos y estructuras irreales
rows: If I'd saved, I'd have a house now.

mistakes: NO: I wish I have more time. -> SI: I wish I had more time.
NO: I wish I would be taller. -> SI: I wish I were taller.
NO: I wish you will stop. -> SI: I wish you would stop.
NO: I wish I didn't go yesterday. -> SI: I wish I hadn't gone yesterday.
NO: I'd rather you leave now. -> SI: I'd rather you left now.
NO: It's time we go. -> SI: It's time we went.
NO: If I studied harder, I would have a better job now. -> SI: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now.

questions.prompt: I wish I ___ taller.
questions.explanation: wish + were (subjuntivo) para un presente irreal.

questions.prompt: She wishes she ___ a car.
'I wish + pasado simple' expresa:
options: un deseo sobre el presente que no es real
questions.answer: un deseo sobre el presente que no es real

questions.prompt: I wish I ___ how to swim.
We wish we ___ nearer the city.
'I wish it ___ so cold.' (hace frio ahora)
Completa: I wish I ___ (have) more free time.
'I wish I could ___ you.'
He wishes he ___ speak French.
'I wish I were on holiday' significa:
options: no estoy de vacaciones pero me gustaria
questions.answer: no estoy de vacaciones pero me gustaria

questions.prompt: En ingles formal, tras 'wish' se prefiere:
questions.explanation: I wish I were / he were...

questions.prompt: I wish you ___ here with me.
'I wish I didn't have to work' significa:
questions.explanation: El deseo contradice la realidad presente.

questions.prompt: I wish I ___ that. (me arrepiento)
She wishes she ___ harder at school.
'I wish + past perfect' expresa:
We wish we ___ tickets earlier.
I wish I ___ to that party. (fui y me arrepiento)
Completa: I wish I ___ (listen) to your advice.
'I wish I had known' significa:
options: no lo sabia entonces y lo lamento
questions.answer: no lo sabia entonces y lo lamento
questions.explanation: Arrepentimiento por no haber sabido algo.

questions.prompt: He wishes he ___ the offer. (la rechazo)
'If only I had saved more money' - la estructura es:
options: If only + past perfect (arrepentimiento del pasado)
questions.answer: If only + past perfect (arrepentimiento del pasado)
questions.explanation: Misma estructura que 'wish' para el pasado.

questions.prompt: I wish I ___ you sooner.
She wishes she ___ so rude to him.
'I wish I could have gone' significa:
options: queria ir pero no fue posible
questions.answer: queria ir pero no fue posible
questions.explanation: could have + participio: posibilidad no cumplida en el pasado.

questions.prompt: Cual muestra un arrepentimiento del pasado?
options: I wish I had taken the job.
I wish I took the job.
I wish I take the job.
questions.answer: I wish I had taken the job.

questions.prompt: I wish you ___ stop interrupting me!
questions.explanation: Queja de un comportamiento -> wish + would.

questions.prompt: 'wish + would' se usa para:
options: quejarse de habitos molestos de otra persona
questions.answer: quejarse de habitos molestos de otra persona
questions.explanation: Deseo de que el otro cambie.

questions.prompt: I wish it ___ stop raining.
Normalmente no decimos 'I wish I would...' porque:
options: no puedes 'ordenar' asi tu propio comportamiento
questions.answer: no puedes 'ordenar' asi tu propio comportamiento
questions.explanation: Para uno mismo se usa wish + could / wish + past simple.

questions.prompt: I wish my neighbours ___ so much noise.
'I wish you would listen' expresa:
options: irritacion: no me escuchas y quiero que lo hagas
questions.answer: irritacion: no me escuchas y quiero que lo hagas
questions.explanation: wish + would suele tener tono de queja.

questions.prompt: I wish the bus ___ come. (llega tarde)
questions.explanation: Deseo de que algo ocurra ya -> wish + would.

questions.prompt: Para una situacion fija (no un comportamiento) se usa:
options: wish + pasado simple ('I wish I had a car'), no 'would'
questions.answer: wish + pasado simple ('I wish I had a car'), no 'would'
questions.explanation: 'would' es para comportamientos / cambios, no para estados fijos.

questions.prompt: I wish he ___ tidy his room.
questions.explanation: Queja de un habito -> wish + would.

questions.prompt: 'I wish it would snow' - vale 'would' aqui?
options: Si - es un deseo de un cambio que no controlamos
questions.answer: Si - es un deseo de un cambio que no controlamos
questions.explanation: Con el tiempo atmosferico wish + would es correcto.

questions.prompt: I wish you ___ complaining.
'I wish you wouldn't do that' es:
options: una queja / peticion suave de dejar un habito
questions.answer: una queja / peticion suave de dejar un habito

questions.prompt: 'If only' es:
If only I ___ more time!
If only I ___ listened to you!
If only he ___ stop shouting.
'If only' admite:
If only she ___ here now.
Completa: If only I ___ (not spend) all my money.
'If only I could fly' expresa:
If only they ___ tell us the truth.
questions.explanation: If only + would (deseo de que otro actue).

questions.prompt: Cual es un arrepentimiento del pasado?
options: If only I had brought an umbrella.
If only I brought an umbrella.
If only I bring an umbrella.
questions.answer: If only I had brought an umbrella.

questions.prompt: 'If only' suele anadir:
If only it ___ so expensive!
I'd rather ___ at home tonight.
I'd rather you ___ me alone. (otro sujeto)
'I'd rather stay' vs 'I'd rather you stayed':
options: mismo sujeto -> base; distinto sujeto -> pasado simple
questions.answer: mismo sujeto -> base; distinto sujeto -> pasado simple

questions.prompt: I'd rather ___ tea than coffee.
She'd rather we ___ now.
questions.explanation: would rather + sujeto + pasado (negativo: didn't + base).

questions.prompt: 'I would rather... than...' compara:
I'd rather walk ___ take the bus.
Would you rather ___ or stay in?
'I'd rather you didn't smoke here' es:
options: una forma educada de pedir que no hagas algo
questions.answer: una forma educada de pedir que no hagas algo

questions.prompt: Completa: I'd rather you ___ (tell) me the truth.
'I'd rather have stayed' (sobre el pasado) significa:
options: habria preferido quedarme (pero no lo hice)
questions.answer: habria preferido quedarme (pero no lo hice)
questions.explanation: would rather have + participio: preferencia sobre el pasado.

questions.prompt: He'd rather his kids ___ less TV.
''d rather' es la contraccion de:
It's time we ___ home.
It's time you ___ to bed. (a un nino)
questions.explanation: It's time + sujeto + pasado simple (aunque el sentido sea 'ahora').

questions.prompt: 'It's time + pasado simple' significa:
options: deberia ocurrir ya / va con retraso
questions.answer: deberia ocurrir ya / va con retraso

questions.prompt: It's high time the government ___ something.
questions.explanation: It's high time + sujeto + pasado simple.

questions.prompt: 'It's time to go' vs 'It's time we went':
options: 'to go' = general; 'we went' = nosotros, y con cierto retraso
questions.answer: 'to go' = general; 'we went' = nosotros, y con cierto retraso
questions.explanation: Con sujeto se usa el pasado; sin sujeto, 'to' + infinitivo.

questions.prompt: It's about time he ___ up.
questions.explanation: It's about time + sujeto + pasado simple.

questions.prompt: Completa: It's time I ___ (get) a proper job.
Tras 'It's time', la forma verbal es:
options: pasado simple (aunque el sentido sea presente/futuro)
questions.answer: pasado simple (aunque el sentido sea presente/futuro)

questions.prompt: It's time we ___ this problem seriously.
Cual es correcta?
options: It's time you learned to drive.
It's time you learn to drive.
It's time you will learn to drive.
questions.answer: It's time you learned to drive.

questions.prompt: 'It's time' + 'to + infinitivo' se usa cuando:
options: no hay un sujeto concreto ('It's time to leave')
questions.answer: no hay un sujeto concreto ('It's time to leave')

questions.prompt: It's high time ___.
questions.explanation: It's high time + sujeto + pasado simple.

questions.prompt: If I had studied medicine, I ___ a doctor now.
questions.explanation: Condicion pasada -> resultado presente: would + base.

questions.prompt: If I weren't so tired, I ___ to the party last night.
questions.explanation: Condicion presente -> resultado pasado: would have + participio.

questions.prompt: Un condicional mixto combina:
options: una condicion y un resultado de tiempos distintos
questions.answer: una condicion y un resultado de tiempos distintos
questions.explanation: Ej.: pasado + presente, o presente + pasado.

questions.prompt: If she had taken the job, she ___ in London now.
questions.explanation: Resultado presente en curso -> would be + -ing.

questions.prompt: If he were more careful, he ___ that accident.
questions.explanation: Condicion presente -> resultado pasado: wouldn't have + participio.

questions.prompt: 'If I had saved money, I would have a house now.' - la condicion esta en el ___, el resultado en el ___.
If I spoke Japanese, I ___ that job in Tokyo last year.
Completa: If you had gone to bed earlier, you ___ (not be) so tired now.
questions.explanation: Condicion pasada -> resultado presente: wouldn't be.
